name: Hotel Harfenwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Harfenwirt is situated in Niederau within the scenic Wildschönau valley, positioned directly opposite the Markbachjoch cable car. Guests enjoy unbeatable ski-in/ski-out convenience to the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau slopes, alongside easy access to summer hiking trails. This family-operated property features authentic Tyrolean country-style rooms, a relaxing wellness suite with saunas, and a restaurant serving classic local dishes.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Harfenwirt in Niederau in the Wildschönau valley provides family hospitality right by the cable car, a sauna wellness area, regional food, and direct Ski Juwel access.
